description: Legacy CaseTrack 7 licences expire on 31 January 2027 with no extension option, creating a hard deadline for decommissioning
mitigation: Contract review completed; vendor approached about a three-month bridging extension as contingency

description: Legacy case data quality is worse than assessed, causing reconciliation failures during migration and incomplete customer histories at go-live
mitigation: Three migration dry runs scheduled; reconciliation tooling built; data cleansing contractor engaged for eight weeks

description: Contact centre agents reject the new interface due to increased handling time during the first weeks after go-live
mitigation: Early access programme for 20 agents; floorwalker support planned for first three weeks; handling time monitored daily post go-live

description: UAT environment may not be ready by 12 October, compressing the user acceptance testing window and delaying go-live readiness sign-off
mitigation: Escalated to Infrastructure leadership; revised provisioning plan requested; parallel preparation of test data and scripts continues

description: Integration with the billing platform fails under production transaction volumes, causing case creation delays
mitigation: Performance testing scheduled for w/c 26 October against production-equivalent volumes

description: Northwind Technologies cannot sustain agreed resource levels through October and November due to competing client commitments
mitigation: Resource commitments written into the statement of work; weekly supplier resource call established

description: Knowledge articles migrated from the legacy system are out of date, reducing the accuracy of the Aurora knowledge assistant
mitigation: Content audit underway; 340 of 1,120 articles reviewed to date; articles not reviewed by 16 October will be excluded from launch

description: Insufficient agent training completion before go-live leaves the contact centre underprepared
mitigation: Training schedule published; completion tracked weekly; minimum 90 per cent completion set as a go-live gate

description: Security assurance and penetration testing are not complete before the go-live decision point, blocking approval to launch
mitigation: Penetration test booked for w/c 19 October; remediation window held in the plan through to 2 November

description: Programme exceeds the approved budget of 2.4m due to extended contractor engagement and additional environment costs
mitigation: Monthly forecast review with Finance; change control required for any commitment above 25k

description: Cutover weekend overruns the agreed 48-hour window, extending the period during which the contact centre operates on manual workarounds
mitigation: Cutover rehearsal scheduled for w/c 26 October; rollback plan to be approved at the October steering committee

description: Data residency requirements are not met by the selected cloud region, creating a regulatory compliance exposure
mitigation: Closed following architecture decision ADR-003 to deploy in the UK South region; confirmed with Legal on 21 August
